summary_1line: Indra reveals the test of King Usinara’s sacrifice, and the story begins of the sage Ashtavakra’s cursed birth and journey to King Janaka’s debate.

image_candidates.scene_text: The hawk transforms into Indra beside the rescued pigeon as King Usinara stands wounded after cutting flesh from his own body.
Inside the womb, the unborn Ashtavakra speaks to his father reciting the Vedas, provoking the sage’s angry curse.
The crooked-bodied boy Ashtavakra stands defiantly at the gate of King Janaka’s sacrifice while guards block his entry.
